about: The shell kept on the device draws the app, not a person. Before this launch's shell has answered, the app's name and its top-level destinations (label and icon) are drawn, and nothing else the shell said: not the context line, not the group labels, not the items below the top level, not the counts, not the person or their menu. When this launch's shell request does not give a shell (a 404, a 5xx, an answer that does not read, no network), the kept shell is replaced by the blank one and stays so until a real shell answers; when it answers with one, everything it says is drawn.

steps.note: The app starts, the day after Ravneet Kaur used it.
